title: Engineering brief interpretation benchmark
description: Public, non-sensitive natural-language briefs across the four NeuroForge problem families with reference extractions in SI units. Expected values are what a careful engineer would read from the text; fields the text does not state are listed under missing and must be assumed, not invented. Briefs the physics cannot satisfy are still valid specifications; the engine, not the interpreter, decides infeasibility.

categories.basic: Plain statements of every required value
categories.units: Values in non-SI or scaled units (mm, cm, ft, in, kN, kg, lbf, lb, g, kW, K, F)
categories.linguistic: Numbers in words, symbols, reordered or indirect phrasing
categories.missing: Required values absent from the brief
categories.ambiguous: Several candidate values for one field
categories.unsupported: Domains or elements outside the four families
categories.infeasible: Valid specifications the engine will report infeasible
